description: Rémi - Mobiliers sur les points arrêt routiers - CA Territoires Vendôme is a dataset listed in data.vendome.catv open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Ce jeu de données liste les mobiliers implantés aux points d'arrêt routiers desservis par le réseau de transport régional. Les données présentées sont indicatives. Coverage: Territoires Vendômois (Loir-et-Cher). The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are mobilité, Rémi, transport, ramassage scolaire, interurbain, lignes régulières. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-08-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-vendome-catv41-centrevaldeloire-portal.
